title: Cosmo picks a library voice itself when a voice line has no sample
description: Fabio's idea (MPI-892 look, 2026-09-30), umbrella MPI-1000. A spoken line asked for with no voice sample ('an old man saying ...'): Cosmo offers [Pick from the voice library | You pick one]. The first opens the voice Flow with the library in its picker (today's open-the-Flow offer). The second has Cosmo choose a voice from js/data/voiceLibrary.js by register, kind and accent to match the words ('an old man', 'a documentary voice', 'a girl'), pass it as the sample and run. Applies to BOTH voice Flows: Text to Speech (Chatterbox) and DramaBox each take an optional sample. First step: check what each does with no sample, and how the agent can pass a library voice as the media.
